reviews.text:
Used Wiggle Waggle (adorable name!) for the first time this week and could not endorse them more. LOVE that they have an online way to schedule your visit, love their flexibility, love that they coordinate a meet and greet before a potential first walk to make both Olive and I feel more comfortable with someone new. After working remote for many years, I've recently started a new hybrid-in-office role so the anxiety we both felt being away from each other was real and Wiggle Waggle seems to really get that.

If you know anything about flat faced dogs high heat and humidity is I am an overprotective mama of a one-eyed-perfect-clingy-peanut-sized-4-year-old-pug. I left an (obnoxiously) long note when I booked about all the ways I needed her to stay cool and hydrated while being walked and they were all over it.

They overly communicate updates on what she "did" outside and send a ton of photos which for a crazy mom like me - I am obsessed with! Posted photos below from their walks today.

Shoutout to Somelies for the amazing care for my pup - she's excited to see you again soon!
Kaylean and Nelly have been so sweet to my pup! I was worried about leaving her while I was at work but she’s so comfortable around them and I get such cute photo updates! Highly recommend.

Highly recommend! Very easy to book a service. Was inexpensive. Whenever an employee checked in on my cat, they sent me updates about how he was doing and pictures/videos of him. It really made me feel like he was in really good hands and I didn’t have to worry about him :)

I can’t recommend this dog walking service enough! From day one, they’ve been incredibly reliable, professional, and genuinely caring. It’s clear they truly love dogs, and my pup gets so excited every time they arrive.

I always receive thoughtful updates, photos, and peace of mind knowing my dog is getting great exercise, attention, and affection while I’m away. They’ve been flexible, communicative, and consistently go above and beyond to make sure my dog is happy and well cared for.

Finding someone you trust with your pet is priceless, and this team has exceeded every expectation. If you’re looking for a dependable, compassionate, and top-notch dog walking service, look no further.
Really enjoyed working with Victor. He’s super communicative and helpful with booking overnight sitters and dog walkers for us.
Always do a great job taking care of my pup! Easy to schedule and personalized service. Great pricing!
Wigglee Waggle is the best! We felt so comfortable leaving out beagle in Kaylean’s care. We loved getting the picture updates and knowing our pup was getting all the love and attention!!

Victor, MD and the entire team at Wiggle Waggle are the best of the best. Communication has always been excellent and their walkers genuinely care.

We were able to travel and adjust from a daily walking schedule to a sitting schedule while away on short notice as our reactive dogs were extra stressed while we were away. Alejandro truly was a god send and his stay made our dogs feel so special and at ease while we were away. We can’t thank the WW team enough for all they did during our short time using them, they go so far above and beyond and really care. When we returned home they even seem better trained on leash and with commands!

Would recommend to any and everyone! Our two rescue dogs loved them and we’ll only use WW and look forward to working with them again!
Great service, very responsive, friendly walkers!

Have had a great experience with Victor and Sebastian! Everyone is extremely responsive, communicative, and most of all, super kind!

I wholly trust this team and am so happy I found them for my pup!
Thank you so much!

Wigglee Waggle is such a fantastic service and I couldn't be happier. My dog Lucy does group walks every day and she loves it. I always get a short report with photos from the walk and I come home to a tired dog... it doesn't get any better. I've also used Wigglee Waggle for dog sitting for as much as 3 weeks at a time. The owner of the business, Satra, is extremely reliable, responsive and trustworthy. To be honest, they've become like family over the last 2 years and I don't know what I would do without them. Long story short, I highly recommend this service to anyone in the area.

Found our go-to walkers! We just moved to the area and had a lovely meet and greet with Victor + Kaylean, and Kaylean has been walking our dog Udon. Super reliable, friendly, and can tell they love dogs. Easy online scheduling! Our new spot in Park Slope!
Our dog Loki had great walks with Victor and Kaylean this week! Not only did he have a great time, we were confident he was in good hands. Thank you both for everything!
Wiggle waggle has been great! Very professional, communicative and overall great experience. We're located in Williamsburg and our walker is Alejandro. Our dog loves him! Highly recommend 🤗
Love working with the whole team! They're so communicative, easy to book with, and our dog loves them! We always know we're in amazing hands!

I’m so glad I found Wiggle Waggle! They are incredibly reliable and kind, and my dog is always so happy after her midday walks. Booking services through their website is quick and easy, and their communication is excellent. I feel completely at ease knowing she’s in such great hands. Highly recommend!

Great dog walking service! Victor is very easy to communicate with, kind, and accommodating. The booking and payment platform is very easy to use and I love getting pictures from my dogs walk :) Would highly recommend!

Highly recommend Wigglee Waggle for dog walking and pet care!! Their team of walkers have walked my dog for a couple of weeks now and I’m so glad I found them! They are super communicative and give a little report after each walk! I met the full team of walkers before they walked my dog which I so appreciate! My dog is often afraid of men, but he immediately loved Victor his main walker!! They are awesome!
Victor is amazing, and his crew is awesome. They are great at communicating and being flexible. His team really love what they do and are so great with my dog.
Wonderful communication, very reliable service. They were able to help us find a dog walker from one day to the next, with a free introduction meeting. Our dog walker is lovely and reliable.
Victor has been amazing. He took his time getting to know our anxious rescue dog and now she asks him for belly rubs. He is super communicative and we are so glad we found him!!
Easy to schedule and great communication!

I love Wiglee and Waggle!! It’s so easy to book walks for my dog Gigi, Victor who walks Gigi is amazing, and this company has saved me this winter! Gigi gets out, no matter the weather, no matter how busy I am.
Thank you!!!

I have been using them for a few years now. They are the best dog walkers in Brooklyn. Attentive to each dog's needs and personalities, communicative and flexible, and the rates are about the best you'll find. Shout out to Victor!

Highly recommend Wiggle Waggle Dog Walker! Tiffany and Victor are extremely reliable and clearly care so much about the dogs they walk. Our dog Emory is always happy and well taken care of, and we have total peace of mind knowing he’s in such great hands. Great communication and truly dependable service.
Super reliable, send great updates with pictures and videos. Needed them last minute for thanksgiving and they came through! Highly recommend.

We've been using wigglewaggle for about two months now and have been very happy with the service. They are responsible, prompt, thoughtful, and affordable. Our dog  looks forward to seeing Victor and Tiffany and always seems happy when I return home. The photos are bonus.

We’ve been using Wiggle Waggle’s dog walking services for almost two months and it has been a great experience so far. I have a very nervous rescue dog who gets extremely anxious and reactive when people come into the apartment. Both Victor and Kristan have been patient, understanding, and so helpful. Other companies in the past were very quick to let us know they weren’t willing to walk a reactive dog and offered no advice or help. Victor has been on the phone with me several times patiently advising and planning the best way to approach this, and Kristan has been super communicative and caring during their walks. We’re already seeing the best results.

Wigglee Waggle has been absolutely wonderful for walks for my foster dog! Victor and my local walker Davante are very responsive and delightful to talk to, the portal is easy to use to set up my schedule. my dog met him ahead of dime, loves him and the reports and photos are super helpful!
Extremely conscientious with my dog who can be frightened by noise. Will continue use Wiggle Waggle’s services where my dog feels comfortable!

We recently adopted a five year old cutie who’s a little tentative with strangers. Victor is amazing. He’s been very patient with her as she gets to know him. We really appreciate all the work they put into being good to our puppy.

We love Wigglee Waggle! I can’t recommend their compassionate, surehanded, conscientious service highly enough. They’re responsive, flexible, and they seem to really care about both animals and people. Our walker, Alejandro, is a total pro, especially with our anxious and fear-aggressive dog, who has really warmed to him. It’s a pleasure to get Wigglee Waggle’s  photo and video updates after each walk. We really trust this company, and they’ve absolutely exceeded our expectations, especially after we had some bad experiences elsewhere. We’re so grateful; thanks, Wigglee Waggle!
Victor and Alejandro are amazing! They go over and beyond. After trying out and interviewing so many dog walkers, these gentleman are the best fit for my doggie. Above all, my doggie loves Alejandro!

Love Wigglee Waggle!  I needed a sitter last minute and as a first time puppy owner, Victor and his team came through.  Not only did I feel safe leaving Frankie with them, I was also reassured throughout the day that she was being well taken care of with photo and text updates.  Highly recommend them!!

In a pinch to find a new dog walker after having my other one for 5+ years, Wigglee Waggle came recommended to me--- and so glad they were! They were so great with getting my dog comfortable with his new walker and now he is excited for his walks. The detailed report of each walk and photos are a nice touch. Couldn't recommend Wigglee Waggle more!
Fantastic and responsive team. Most reliable and professional service we have used. Highly recommend

Best dog walking service in Brooklyn. Kind, accommodating, punctual, and they send detailed reviews of every service. I particularly appreciate their care and attentiveness to my dog who is very shy and generally untrusting of adult humans, and they did everything they could to always accommodate my scheduling needs, even at last minutes notice. Victor is amazing and very responsive. I can't recommend them more highly!

We have been using Wigglee Waggle for the last two years for our dog Gnocchi. Victor is the best and is super patient and kind with Gnocchi who can be a bit timid. We have been super happy with their services and the ease of scheduling.

We love Wigglee Waggle! They’ve stuck with us for a couple apartment moves, and our dog has been so happy with them. Victor and Tiffany and the rest of the team are thoughtful, very responsive and always send the best pics. It’s a huge weight off our minds to have such excellent pet care, and we love supporting a local company in our community.
